text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B, D, and E only after very large losses suggests I may have delayed decisions to avoid admitting a mistake; I should reassess each holding using its future prospects, not my average cost.","Buying Stock A and E again soon after selling them reminds me to make trades based on a clear portfolio plan, rather than on whether a position feels like a winner or loser.","Rarely trading can prevent impulsive decisions, but after a sustained decline I should review concentration, risk, and whether my holdings still fit my goals."]}
